kev_metadata.shortDescription: The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS 1 contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code on an affected system or cause an affected system to reload. An attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by sending a crafted SNMP packet to an affected system via IPv4 or IPv6.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS Software SNMP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

title: Cisco IOS Software SNMP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in vRealize Operations Manager API prior to 8.4 may allow a malicious actor with network access to the vRealize Operations Manager API to perform a SSRF attack to steal administrative credentials.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: VMware Server Side Request Forgery in vRealize Operations Manager API

title: VMware Server Side Request Forgery in vRealize Operations Manager API

kev_metadata.requiredAction: For all affected software assets for which updates exist, the only acceptable remediation actions are: 1) Apply updates; OR 2) remove affected assets from agency networks. Temporary mitigations using one of the measures provided at https://www.cisa.gov/uscert/ed-22-02-apache-log4j-recommended-mitigation-measures are only acceptable until updates are available.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains a vulnerability where JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled JNDI-related endpoints, allowing for remote code execution.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

title: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Juniper Junos OS on SRX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to webauth_operation.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Juniper Junos OS SRX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability

title: Juniper Junos OS SRX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability

kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Oracle E-Business Suite contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Payments. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Payments.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Oracle E-Business Suite Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability

title: Oracle E-Business Suite Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
